name: Unity Hub
author: Unity Technologies Inc.
summary: Manage multiple installations of the Unity Editor, create new projects, and access your work.
description: The Unity Hub is a standalone application that streamlines the way you navigate, download, and manage your Unity projects and installations.

verification.label: Hashes copied from upstream package manifests (winget-pkgs, Homebrew cask). Not independently re-computed; signatures not checked. Linux (Flatpak) installs come from Flathub, whose repository is signed; Flathub publishes no file checksum.
